notes.title: Update 2017-03-13
notes.notes:
Update Notes:


     New motion sensor guard at first motion sensor encounter. Should help new players distinguish the nature of the motion sensors.
     Checkpoint placement changes to level 5.07 to make the level more fair/less frustrating.


Thanks for your continued support, and let us know if you run into any issues!

Don't get caught!
-Kris

notes.title: Update 2017-01-16
notes.notes:
Update Notes:


    More forgiving Sawblades - Sawblades in Mission 3 will no longer hit you while their retract and extend animations are playing. While still challenging, this change should help smooth out the difficulty curve of the game.
    Minor graphical fixes


Thanks for your continued support, and let us know if you run into any issues!

Don't get caught!
-Kris

notes.title: Master Spy Cinema Update
notes.notes:
For those wanting to go back and rewatch the cutscenes you've unlocked, check out this update, grab some popcorn, and kick back. Cutscenes unlock via Story mode progress, Level Select progress, or Cheat Codes, to fit your play style.

Updates:
- Cutscene Select Menu - Rewatch cutscenes that you've unlocked!
- Score rankings have been adjusted. They are still demanding, but a little less demanding. Good luck Master Spies!
- minor text fixes
